description: AM Isa card-game artist/source registry. Artwork records are grouped by planned egg releases, while source credits remain reusable and independent of pet metadata or image hosting.

artists.notes: User-created edit/composition for AM Isa. Public creator display name can be updated if the owner prefers a specific credit.
Artist name and profile URL provided with the original Pixabay attribution.

Artist-created Adopt Me fan-art replies verified in their own Reddit thread. Research includes three identifiable drawings covering four pet types (Wolf, Ghost Wolf, Turtle, and neon Cute-A-Cabra), plus additional drawings whose species are not yet verified.

permission.notes: The project owner reports direct permission from the Reddit artist. Public Reddit thread shows artwork authored by the artist, but original permission evidence and exact reuse scope have not been recorded; do not treat third-party requests or individual illustrations as fully cleared for card publication until reviewed.
